concept: C36 rigid dual-arch cassette with removable service guide studs
owner_authority: Stage36 delegation permits allocation of unspecified surroundings as proposals after drawings review; no canonical adoption or physical authority.

datum.A: Rear-carrier upper crossmember top z62 (study geometry), not the PCB or cover
datum.B: Panel-locked x/y frame; rear-carrier locating side face parallel to y
datum.C: Rear-carrier end stop parallel to x; positive 3-2-1 seating, no bolt-friction datum
datum.rotation_reference: rotation about each housing exit; translation is bounded at that exit; no distant rotation lever silently omitted
datum.scope: Proposed maximum obligations, not measured capability. Signed global bow amplitude does NOT establish local slope; slope must independently meet rotation obligation. No favorable correlation credited.

root_thread: Proposed M3 blind thread z84..90 in integral post top; integral boss/post/replacement-crossmember connection remains a new unqualified structural interface
mount_screw: Proposed M3x16: bearing plane z101 on 1mm washer, 10mm bushing to z90, tip z85 gives 5mm engagement; no selected fastener or torque
cover_ribs: PROPOSAL: no ribs/fasteners below z105 inside this opening; perimeter fastening outside the opening must preserve carrier anchors and core path; exact lid joint/fasteners not qualified
assembly_policy: K-PWR disconnected first, then existing supported 40mm core extraction; install long guide studs one at a time in place of short mount screws; retain all sleeves and housing keepers; common +z15 unmate, +z75 total cassette removal. Reverse the same translations and thread operations. No single-end release while cassette is closed. FAILED removal interface: D6 stud heads block D4.4 bushings at +32mm; +75mm is hypothetical only, no revised mechanism adopted.
